cohort: 1508 pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) receiving care at the Hospital das Clinicas da Faculdade de Medicina da Universidade de Sao Paulo between 2012 and 2020.
finding: Spontaneous labor onset was the strongest independent predictor of vaginal delivery among women with GDM, while previous cesarean delivery, fetal distress, and multiple pregnancy significantly reduced this likelihood.
mod_finding: The study found an overall cesarean section rate of 65.3% among women with GDM, with spontaneous labor onset strongly predicting vaginal delivery and factors like previous cesarean delivery, fetal distress, and multiple pregnancy reducing its likelihood.
